tests.title: A return on the last day of the window is accepted
History counts every account in the linked group
Only approved returns count toward the history
The value is price x quantity
Decisions at the score thresholds (30 and 70)
Orders not yet delivered are rejected
An item can have only one open return
History covers the 90 days before the request
The refund total must be more than 1000
Every reason comes with its message
Evaluations are recorded in the history

bugs.why: getPolicy looks the category up as written on the order ("Electronics"), but the policy keys are lowercase, so every category looks unknown and nothing can be returned
bugs.fix: Normalise the category before the lookup: trim and lowercase it.

bugs.why: a score of exactly 70 goes to manual review instead of being rejected (> instead of >=)
the return-window check rejects a request made on the last day of the window (>= instead of >)
bugs.fix: Only reject when daysSinceDelivery > policy.windowDays(); day 30 of a 30-day window is still inside it.

bugs.why: getAccountGroup only follows the customer's direct links, so accounts linked through another account (A - B - C) are missed
bugs.fix: Walk the links until no new account turns up (a breadth-first search over linkedAccountIds()).

bugs.why: recentRefunds counts every past return, including rejected and pending ones, not just approved (refunded) ones
bugs.fix: Keep only returns with status APPROVED.

bugs.why: the value of the return ignores the quantity (price only)
